verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a downloadable machine-readable spec: https://docs.helix-db.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key. The documented HTTP API (POST /v2/query, shared by local servers and the Cloud gateway) gives the spec a concrete surface to describe, and an llms.txt adds a further machine-readable entry point. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the OpenAPI spec, and evidence of what it covers (the query endpoint versus Cloud admin APIs) or whether it is complete and current.
